title: Investment Plots on the Tindivanam Highway | Guide
description: Investment plots along the Pondicherry–Tindivanam highway: how to judge approach roads, approvals and resale before you buy, and our verification process.
h1: Investment Plots on the Tindivanam Highway
lead: The highway toward Tindivanam is where many of the larger layouts and investment plots sit. It rewards buyers who check the details and punishes those who buy on a promise.
wa: Hi, I am interested in investment plots on the Tindivanam highway

guide.label: Tell us what you need in Tindivanam Highway

paras: Larger layouts, easier prices and the pull of a major road make this belt attractive for people who hold land for the longer term. The trade-off is distance from the centre of town, so the real question is what is being built around the plot, not just what is promised.

blocks.h: How to judge a plot on the highway
bullets: Approach road: a good plot on a bad road is a bad plot
Approval: confirm the number and the issuing authority, and check it is current
Frontage and setbacks: highway plots can be subject to restrictions near the road
Services: water, power and drainage actually in place, not only planned
Resale: how many plots have really sold, and to whom

paras: The price difference between an approved and an unapproved layout is the whole story. Unapproved plots can be hard to finance and hard to resell. Our guide on [approved vs unapproved layouts](/guides/approved-vs-unapproved-layout-plot-pondicherry) explains what to ask.
We develop layouts in this belt ourselves, so we can show you the approval, the parent documents and the ground. See [our layouts](/our-projects) and ask what is open now.

items.q: Are highway plots a good investment?
items.a: They can be, for buyers willing to hold. Value depends on approvals, approach road and what actually gets built nearby, so verify each of these before buying.

items.q: Can I get a bank loan for a plot here?
items.a: Approved layouts with clean title can usually be financed. Unapproved plots usually cannot. We tell you early which category a plot falls in.

items.q: How do I check a layout’s approval?
items.a: Ask for the approval number and issuing authority and have the plan compared with the ground. We do this for every property we show.
